output.reason: [ev-f9d32317b49c] is a single changelog line saying the server now makes deep copies of objects returned by informers. It names no setting, resource, flag or other environment state that would make an installation exposed, and it does not describe any operator-visible effect. The proposed exposure, product-version argo-cd >=3.0.0, uses an op that is meant for another product's version. It just repeats the target release, so it would flag every environment without anything in the evidence to back that. To decide, we would need the PR or upgrade-guide text (#22173/#22179) showing whether any configuration or runtime condition (for example, plugins or extensions that mutate informer objects) changes behaviour. Without that, we cannot tell whether the right exposure is undecidable or no exposure at all.
